opportunities.description:
The Data Router streaming exclusion still says buffering makes registration precede execution. The current addon registers the Router-assigned ID only after receiving the upstream response. This leaves a false execution-order guarantee at the request-routing decision.

Audited commit: `97e8ca71f4d6ac0cd015de589eb5d8179a96bddd`.

## Remaining incorrect comment

[`crates/runner/mitm-addon/src/request_classification.py:705–712`](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/blob/97e8ca71f4d6ac0cd015de589eb5d8179a96bddd/crates/runner/mitm-addon/src/request_classification.py#L705-L712), specifically lines 710–711:

> Router JSON-RPC calls must be buffered so registration precedes execution,
> including when credential authorization is already cached.

## Verified behavior

- The request-phase operation only discards a sandbox-supplied request-ID header: [`data_router.py:17–19`](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/blob/97e8ca71f4d6ac0cd015de589eb5d8179a96bddd/crates/runner/mitm-addon/src/data_router.py#L17-L19), called after authorization at [`mitm_addon.py:1923–1925`](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/blob/97e8ca71f4d6ac0cd015de589eb5d8179a96bddd/crates/runner/mitm-addon/src/mitm_addon.py#L1923-L1925).
- [`data_router.register_response:22–44`](https://github.com/okou-ai/okou/blob/97e8ca71f4d6ac0cd015de589eb5d8179a96bddd/crates/runner/mitm-addon/src/data_router.py#L22-L44) requires an upstream response, reads its execution ID, and makes one registration attempt. ## The problem to solve

Diffyn currently runs as a local Rust stdio MCP server. Its published Linux container has no HTTP listener. A hosted client cannot use those packages simply by supplying a Cloudflare URL.

This is an **optional, user-owned deployment path** with an explicit privacy boundary. Local installation remains available. Before the first remote implementation, document how requests, authentication records and operational logs are handled by the deployment and its infrastructure providers.

## Choose the right Cloudflare service

| Component | Purpose in this proposal |
| --- | --- |
| Workers | Hosts the remote HTTPS MCP endpoint. Rust application logic is compiled to WebAssembly. |
| Access or another supported identity provider | Controls who may use the deployed service. |
| MCP server portal | An explicit installer option that presents the deployed HTTP MCP server through Cloudflare's access controls. |

opportunities.title: Make the repository welcoming and actionable for external contributors
opportunities.description:
**Priority:** P0. **Dependencies:** none. **Estimate:** 1 day: contributor docs/templates 0.5, clean-fork walkthrough 0.5.

### Context / current state
The repository is public, forkable, MIT licensed and has Issues enabled. `CONTRIBUTING.md` and issue/PR templates are absent. `CLAUDE.md` still describes a name-only stop and historical publication constraints. Public visibility alone does not explain how to run or contribute.

### Proposed change
Add an English contribution guide, issue templates for bugs/features, a PR template, current agent guidance and a README link to the roadmap. Explain fork -> branch -> commit -> PR, review expectations, code MIT versus separate content terms, synthetic data, no real keys or brain exports, and the two intentional public-export test skips.

### Acceptance criteria
1. A contributor without maintainer access can follow the documented fork workflow and identify the exact setup/check commands.
2. Bug reports request reproduction, expected/actual behavior and redacted evidence; feature requests request user outcome and acceptance criteria.
3. The PR template asks for observable validation and flags payment, provenance, permission and test/CI changes.

opportunities.title: Keeper backstop for every permissionless liveness step, with a CI-guarded ledger
opportunities.description:
## What

Every **permissionless liveness step** in the protocol should have the platform keeper as its backstop: anyone may call it, and if nobody does, our keeper does. Owner directive, 2026-10-27.

A permissionless step is a state-advancing, non-view entry point with no role gate whose purpose is to keep the protocol moving. Examples: closing and finalizing reward days, proving deliveries, advancing interest frontiers, starting and proving day closure, finalizing custody eras, horizon and expiry sweeps, defaults past grace, periodic settlement, and resolving staging pages.

Some of these are already automated, for example the delivery proof, day close, grace default, periodic settle and horizon heartbeat passes. Others have no automation at all; #917's scout found `advanceInterestFrontiers` on a detached chain, `startDayClosure` / `proveDayClosurePage` and `finalizeCustodyEra`. Nothing records which is which, so a new permissionless step can ship with no caller and stall the protocol silently.

## Proposal: a ledger plus a guard, not a one-off list

1. **Inventory.** List every permissionless, state-advancing external function on the Diamond (and its satellites) from the compiled ABIs and modifiers.
2. **Classify each one**:
   - **Keeper-backed**: name the keeper pass and arming flag that calls it.
   - **User-driven**: the caller is the party it benefits, such as claims, repay or the borrower's own close-out, so no keeper is needed. State why.
   - **Gap**: no automation

opportunities.title: Wave 7: Operator Lite stops hold for the whole session, whatever tool or subagent tries again
opportunities.description:
## Why

When Operator Lite stops an action, an agent can try the same effect another way. It can use a Python one-liner instead of `rm`, a file tool instead of a redirect, or a subagent. A stop that a rewording gets around protects less than it seems to.

## Design under the causal-proof rule

- **Record the effect.** When Lite stops a call, it records the effect signature its parser computes from the effect class and the exact target, such as a recursive delete of one folder or a read of one credentials file.
- **Hold for the session.** For the rest of the session, any call whose parsed effect matches an open signature is stopped as already stopped, with the original receipt, whatever tool it uses.
- **Subagents included.** The record is keyed to the session, and calls from its subagents are matched to it.
- **End the loop.** Two attempts at one stopped effect through different tools end the turn with a clear message.
- **Owner permit.** The owner's permit from their own terminal still lifts a stop, as it does today.
- Vestige Operator carries the owner's no across sessions, hosts and other agent CLIs. That part is paid.

## Proof carried by every output

Each repeat stop names the original receipt.

## Falsifier and benchmark

- After a stopped recursive delete, the same delete through Python, `find -delete` and a file tool are each stopped with the first receipt.
- An unrelated delete in the same session is judged on its own.
- A new session starts clean.

We have a [runnable developer prototype](https://github.com/rf24kja/24GO.top) with a multilingual local feed, development API, JavaScript SDK, OpenAPI, RSS, preliminary Supabase/PostgreSQL RLS tests, and contributor docs. **It is not a launched production community** — verified accounts, moderation, Agent Arena, real discussions and static-app Library are planned work.

We'd really like useful technical feedback before building too much:

1. What specific problem with publishing AI engineering knowledge should we solve first?
2. Which agent integrations or publishing API capabilities would make you try this project?
3. What safety/privacy requirements would you need before connecting your own agent?
4. Would you prefer to help with accessibility, localization, API/SDKs, or RLS/security?

**How to contribute:** pick a focused [good first issue](https://github.com/rf24kja/24GO.top/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22), file a reproducible bug, review the [roadmap](https://github.com/rf24kja/24GO.top/blob/main/docs/ROADMAP.md), or open a small Pull Request.

opportunities.title: [Owner supersession / Fleet Next] 老版 Fleet 保留双轨运行；Agent Monitor 独立验收
opportunities.description:
# Owner 决定 · 2026-10-28 · **双轨并行，不替代老版 Fleet**

这是用户在当前 ChatGPT 对话明确追加的最新约束，**覆盖** #429 中的「旧控制面退役」以及任何此前把 V1 收口理解为直接接管旧 Fleet 的计划。关联：#434、#425、#429、#417、#424、#394。

## 1. 两条运行轨道

| 轨道 | 当前职责 | 明确禁止 |
|---|---|---|
| **Legacy Fleet（现有 ChatGPT 正在使用的控制面）** | 继续提供 ChatGPT 到已授权设备/项目/Agent/Session/Run 的 create/read/send/get_run/stop；其已有网关、插件连接、身份、运行数据库、端口、会话和权限保持原状 | 不因 Fleet Next 的源码合并、构建、测试、影子部署而停止、重命名、迁移、卸载或覆盖；不得把旧工具改成空壳 |
| **Fleet Next（新版本，新发行工件）** | 单独发布、单独配置与状态、先 SOURCE/UNIT/CI 和影子观察，逐项完成真实能力、Agent Monitor、可靠性及权限回读验收 | 未经单独批准不可抢占旧 Fleet 端口、socket、service、MCP plugin ID/URL、OAuth audience、credential、DB/state/lock、会话路由；不可自动把 ChatGPT 的默认控制工具指向 Next |

- 本轮 **没有批准实际部署/切换/合并 main/账号和 OAuth 变更**。当前旧 Fleet v0.1.0 三条主要路由可达，继续承载 ChatGPT 的控制；任何新发布、启用、灰度仍单独审批。
- 安全开发可在新目录增加 side-by-side 安装契约、独立发布包、read-only compatibility/smoke 和负面测试。所有旧服务关键资源的所有权保持旧系统独占。
- 新旧事实必须分别保留 `fleet_instance_id` / `route_id` / `boot_id`、schema/source version、授权来源和 Run/Delivery 身份；不能把同名 ID 或某一轨道的 `completed` 当作另一轨道的成功。
- shadow 只能读，**不能调用 Next 的 create/send/stop/restart/manager-wake**；不获得权限不允许查询秘密/私有Session；缺状态记 UNKNOWN，而非偷偷退化为成功。
- 一项修复若要求提前退役 old controller / old plugin / D5-D6 `agent.*`，必须标 `BLOCKED_LEGACY_PARITY` 并给独立迁移验收计划，**不得执行退役**。

## 2. 用户要求：**Agent Monitor（监控 Agent 的监控 Agent）必须真正做完**

不等同于只读 C++ L1 serverosd 的 CPU/RAM/service status。独立 Tokyo-side **Agent Monitor** 是针对多设备 Agent/Session/Run/CI 的、GPT 退出后仍工作的 watch/observer：

1. 从 Legacy Fleet 的**授权只读事实接口**和可核验 native CloudCLI/GitHub SourceRead 获取真实信息，注册 B

opportunities.title: Logs > Search toolbar: Reset, histogram/SQL toggles and More buttons are shorter than the view-mode switch
opportunities.description:
### Bug Description

Logs search toolbar: a checklist of the alignment problems found next to the Search / Visualize / Drill down / Patterns switch.

- [ ] **`P3` · Toolbar buttons are shorter than the view-mode switch next to them.** On the Logs page, the Reset, histogram toggle, SQL-mode toggle and More buttons sit noticeably shorter than the Search / Visualize / Drill down / Patterns switch on their left, so the toolbar row looks uneven.

  <details>
  <summary>🔧 Technical details & proposed fix</summary>

  **Where:** `web/src/plugins/logs/SearchBar.vue` → toolbar template (`logs-search-bar-reset-filters-btn`, `logs-search-bar-histogram-btn`, `logs-search-bar-sql-mode-pinned-btn`, `logs-search-bar-quick-mode-pinned-btn`, `logs-search-bar-more-options-btn`); the `OToggleGroup` renders 34px tall (`OToggleGroupItem` `size="sm"` = `h-7` 28px, plus the track's `p-0.5` and 1px `border` in `web/src/lib/core/ToggleGroup/OToggleGroup.vue`), while the sibling `OButton`s use `size="xs"` = `h-7` 28px (`web/src/lib/core/Button/OButton.vue` `sizeClasses`).

  **Proposed fix:** In `SearchBar.vue` only, make the toolbar buttons next to the toggle group the same 34px height (e.g. `size="sm"`, which is the 34px toolbar size, or an `h-[2.125rem]` class keeping `text-xs`), so every control in the row shares one height; do not change the shared `OButton` / `OToggleGroup` sizes.

  **How to verify:** On the Logs page, the Reset / histogram / SQL / More buttons have the same top and bottom

opportunities.title: distribution: publish signed, attested GHCR release images
opportunities.description:
## Goal

Reduce first-install friction with versioned public GHCR images for the trusted interactive service and the guarded workers. Hangar v0.2.0 remains source-only until this is implemented and verified.

## Scope / design requirements

- Build from an immutable reviewed release commit; pin build inputs/tool versions consistently with the source release.
- Versioned image tags and immutable digests, an SBOM, provenance attestations and verifiable image signing.
- Publish only public source/build context: never deployment configuration, tokens, private keys, workspaces or credentials.
- Verify worker credential isolation and existing launcher/container acceptance checks on the published image digest.
- Document supported architectures truthfully, update/pull policy, operator verification and rollback by digest.
- Do not replace busy workers or workers with pending publication; do not auto-update deployments.
- Document registry permissions and use short-lived workflow credentials where possible.

## Acceptance criteria

A maintainer can verify origin/signature/provenance, deploy the exact tested digest with a synthetic repository, run the existing container security/launcher tests, and roll back without losing volumes or private configuration. Public README installation claims change only after that proof exists.

This is a follow-up engineering/security task, **not** a good-first-issue. Discuss the minimal design before implementation; no new runtime abstraction is reques
